author: Unreal Engine
description:
Discover how to design and build production-quality character rigs directly inside Unreal Engine. 

This session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 walks through practical techniques for creating modular, animator-friendly rigs that take full advantage of Unreal Engine’s real-time environment. 

The lessons learned can also be readily applicable in UEFN. Watch to learn how to prepare and structure rigs for dynamic, believable motion using Control Rig physics, empowering you to bring characters to life without leaving the engine.

Find out more about using Unreal Engine for animation here: unrealengine.com/uses/animation

#Animation, #Rigging, #ControlRig, #UEFN, #AnimatedCharacters, #UnrealEngine, #UnrealFestChicago2026
title: Build It in Engine: Modern Rigging with Control Rig & Dataflow | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
This talk recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026 explores how best to work with Unreal Engine and Clo/Marvelous Designer in combination, with a focus on MetaHuman technology. 

MetaHuman DNA imports have recently been incorporated into Clo software. We show how to create a MetaHuman using Unreal Engine, bring it into Clo, and then bring the clothing back into Unreal Engine. Back in Unreal Engine, we offer some tips on how to easily turn your Clo clothing into an Outfit asset, and go over some best practices around getting the best results from this system as it evolves. We also discuss the Fab marketplace and how to create clothing assets to sell there.

Find out more about MetaHuman here: metahuman.com

#Clo, #MarvelousDesigner, #MetaHuman, #DigitalClothing, #VirtualFashion, #UnrealEngine, #UnrealFestChicago2026
title: MetaHumans x Clo: Workflows and Best Practices | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
